race.comment: KHE SANH NZ (1) drew wide once again last start but produced a strong effort, beaten 5.5 metres into third at Addington over 1980m. Sure to enjoy an economical run from this much better draw. His recent form is full of merit. Good enough to take out a race like this. KYCORDEN (7) has been competitive of late and kept the ball rolling last time when 6 metres from the winner in fourth over 1609m at this track. Steps up a level but he is up to the task. BEEJAYS BLING (8) is looming as a real threat after a better effort last start, finishing third at Tamworth over 1609m. CAPTAIN MIKI (2) is the best of the rest after finishing fifth over 1609m at this track last time out.
